initiative: Reduce unplanned downtime across three sites by 30% within 12 months

key_results: Reduce total unplanned downtime minutes by 30% from baseline
Decrease mean time to detect (MTTD) by 40%
Lower mean time to restore (MTTR) by 25%
Implement real-time monitoring with 95% coverage across sites
Deploy automated alerting and runbook automation for top 5 failure modes

sprint_plan.focus: Baseline current downtime, collect historical data and define top failure modes
sprint_plan.ships: Downtime baseline report, prioritized failure-mode list

sprint_plan.focus: Instrument monitoring gaps and add missing telemetry across sites
sprint_plan.ships: Expanded monitoring coverage (95% target) and dashboards

sprint_plan.focus: Build alerting and on-call runbooks for top 5 failure modes
sprint_plan.ships: Automated alerts and runbooks for top failure modes

sprint_plan.focus: Implement automated remediation for highest-impact remediation paths
sprint_plan.ships: Automated remediation playbooks for top remediation actions

sprint_plan.focus: Run simulated incidents and iterate on alerts and runbooks
sprint_plan.ships: Post-simulated incident run-up, updated runbooks and alert thresholds

sprint_plan.focus: Measure impact, validate reductions, and hand off steady-state monitoring
sprint_plan.ships: Final downtime reduction report and handoff to ops with SLAs

blockers: Incomplete historical telemetry and inconsistent data sources
Limited automation capacity and cross-team bandwidth for sprint work
Dependency on third-party vendor for critical monitoring components
success_metric: 30% reduction in total unplanned downtime minutes versus baseline within 12 weeks measured by downtime metric
